moves.name: supportValue
moves.text: def supportValue (B : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ j ∈ S, B ^ j

moves.name: mask
moves.text:
def mask (B b len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  B ^ len - 1 - (b-1) * supportValue B S

moves.name: Tile
moves.text:
structure Tile where
  west : ℕ
  north : ℕ
  east : ℕ
  south : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

moves.name: headColor
moves.text: def headColor (q b : ℕ) : ℕ := 2 * q + b + 2

moves.name: start
moves.text: def start : Tile := ⟨2, 435, 3, 1⟩

moves.name: transitionRow
moves.text:
def transitionRow (j : Fin 430) : ℕ × Tile :=
  let a := action j
  let d := a.2.1.toNat
  (j.val + 1, ⟨(1-d) * rail false a.2.2, headColor (j.val/2) (j.val%2),
    d * rail true a.2.2, a.1.toNat⟩)

moves.name: copyRows
moves.text:
def copyRows (a : ℕ) : List (ℕ × Tile) :=
  (List.range 2).map (fun b => (433 - 2*a + b, ⟨0,432*a+b,0,432*a+b⟩))

moves.name: signalRows
indexedRows
moves.text:
/-- Every constructor family in printed order; the two values of a and d
are enumerated explicitly without changing their row formulas. -/
def indexedRows : List (ℕ × Tile) :=
  [(0, start)] ++ List.ofFn transitionRow ++ (copyRows 0 ++ copyRows 1) ++
    (signalRows false ++ signalRows true) ++ tailRows

moves.name: orderedRows
moves.text:
/-- Exchanging only the copy and signal blocks puts the complete table in
index order. The permutation proof below does not rely on finite sorting. -/
def orderedRows : List (ℕ × Tile) :=
  [(0, start)] ++ List.ofFn transitionRow ++ (copyRows 1 ++ copyRows 0) ++
    (signalRows true ++ signalRows false) ++ tailRows

moves.name: row_indices_exact
moves.text:
theorem row_indices_exact : orderedRows.map Prod.fst = List.range 942 := by
  decide +kernel

moves.name: ordered_count
moves.text:
theorem ordered_count : orderedRows.length = 942 := by
  have h := congrArg List.length row_indices_exact
  simpa only [List.length_map, List.length_range] using h

moves.name: tile
moves.text:
/-- The actual indexed tile, selected from the complete ordered row list. -/
def tile (i : Fin 942) : Tile := (orderedRows[i.val]'(by rw [ordered_count]; exact i.isLt)).2

moves.name: selectorWeight
physicalPosition
moves.text:
/-- The sorted physical position, written over all 941 non-Start rows. -/
def physicalPosition (i : Fin 942) : ℕ :=
  if i.val = 0 then 0 else 1 + ((orderedRows.drop 1).map (fun row =>
    (2 ^ 44 - 1 + selectorWeight row.2 - selectorWeight (tile i)) / 2 ^ 44)).sum

moves.name: radix
moves.text: def radix : ℕ := 2 ^ 47

moves.name: width
moves.text: def width : ℕ := 47 * 2011

moves.name: beta
moves.text: def beta : ℕ := radix ^ 2011 - 1

moves.name: lowSupport
moves.text: irreducible_def lowSupport : Finset ℕ := Finset.range 951 ∪ Finset.Ico 960 986 ∪ {1004}

moves.name: lowPort
moves.text: def lowPort : ℕ := mask radix 2 2011 lowSupport

moves.name: highPrefix
moves.text:
/-- All nonzero high-mask digits occur in this1006-digit prefix. -/
def highPrefix : List ℕ :=
  4 :: (List.replicate 916 8 ++ List.replicate 43 0 ++ List.replicate 9 1 ++
    List.replicate 18 0 ++ List.replicate 8 1 ++ List.replicate 9 0 ++ [1, 2 ^ 45 - 4])

moves.name: highDigits
moves.text: def highDigits : List ℕ := highPrefix ++ List.replicate 1005 0

moves.name: highPort
moves.text: def highPort : ℕ := Nat.ofDigits radix highDigits

moves.name: ports
moves.text: def ports (K : ℤ) : Fin 4 → ℤ := ![beta, K, lowPort, highPort + beta]

moves.name: radix
moves.text: abbrev radix : ℕ := CurrentMasks2011.radix

moves.name: Entry
moves.text:
/-- The34 control entries use the actual packed west/north/east/south order. -/
abbrev Entry := Fin 942 ⊕ (Fin 8 ⊕ (Fin 9 ⊕ (Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 9)))

moves.name: position
moves.text:
def position : Entry → ℕ
  | .inl i => physicalPosition i
  | .inr (.inl j) => 978 + j.val -- west
  | .inr (.inr (.inl j)) => 960 + j.val -- north
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl j))) => 969 + j.val -- east
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j))) => 942 + j.val -- south

moves.name: weight
moves.text:
def weight : Entry → ℕ
  | .inl i => selectorWeight (tile i)
  | .inr (.inl j) => 2 ^ (10 + j.val)
  | .inr (.inr (.inl j)) => 2 ^ (18 + j.val)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl j))) => 2 ^ (27 + j.val)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr j))) => 2 ^ (35 + j.val)

moves.name: Term
moves.text: abbrev Term := Fin 3 ⊕ Entry

moves.name: exponent
moves.text:
def exponent : Term → ℕ
  | .inl j => ![18, 1004, 2020] j
  | .inr e => 1005 - position e

moves.name: coefficient
moves.text:
def coefficient : Term → ℕ
  | .inl _ => 1
  | .inr e => 2 * weight e

moves.name: rawWord
moves.text: def rawWord (r : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ t : Term, coefficient t * r ^ exponent t

moves.name: K
moves.text: def K : ℕ := rawWord radix

moves.name: ports
moves.text:
/-- The four actual integer ports, including the one source high-mask shift. -/
def ports : Fin 4 → ℤ := CurrentMasks2011.ports (K : ℤ)

moves.name: expressionAt
moves.text:
/-- Literal arithmetic syntax, in the same coordinate and port order as
`Carrier65.core`. All four ports are single integer-constant leaves. -/
def expressionAt (p : Fin 4 → ℤ) : Expr (Fin 14) :=
  let J : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 0
  let F : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 1
  let alpha : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 2
  let z : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 3
  let f : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 4
  let i : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 5
  let T : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 6
  let s : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 7
  let w : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 8
  let n : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 9
  let eta : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 10
  let zeta : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 11
  let y : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 12
  let gamma : Expr (Fin 14) := .var 13
  let b := Expr.constant (p 0) * J
  let q := b + 1
  let C := q - F - alpha
  let X := w * q
  let Y := s * q ^ 3
  let E := X * Y
  let k := eta + zeta
  let ell := E * k * Y
  let c := k * Y + eta
  let a := E + Y
  let H := 4 * a + 3
  let delta := a ^ 2 + H
  let D := X + a * c + gamma * H
  let rank := (b * (q - F) + alpha) * (q ^ 2 - 1) +
    (Expr.constant (p 2) + q * Expr.constant (p 3)) * J
  let tau := E * n + k - rank
  let V := f ^ 2 * (c * T - rank) - c
  let S := i * delta * c ^ 2
  let P := tau ^ 2 - ell * (ell + k)
  let Q := D ^ 2 - delta * c ^ 2
  let U := S ^ 2 * (V ^ 2 - y ^ 2) + y ^ 2
  let W := (Expr.constant (p 1) + w) * C + (q - F) - z * b
  let Z := delta * f ^ 2 - S ^ 2
  P * Q * U * W * Z - delta

moves.name: expression
moves.text:
/-- The current ports retain the full kernel and both complete masks. -/
def expression : Expr (Fin 14) := expressionAt CurrentWindowCarry2011.ports

moves.name: positiveShift
naturalExpression
moves.text: def naturalExpression : Expr (Fin 14) := positiveShift expression
